planner.description: Product Owner. Clarifies requirements, creates backlog issues, dispatches Architect. Resumes for final report.

architect.description: Sub-agent. Creates specs (EARS + contract), branch, empty main PR. Decomposes into capsules, dispatches Coder swarm and Reviewer.

coder.description: Creates git worktree from spec branch, implements capsule, opens draft PR. Handles retry via session resume.

reviewer.description: Batch reviews workspace PRs against capsules. Merges approved PRs to spec branch. Dispatches Coder retries. Opens bug issues on >4 failures. Runs automated DOM-based e2e testing via Tauri MCP. Does final coherence check on main PR.

e2e-tester.description: Visual/DOM testing subagent dispatched by Reviewer. Takes screenshots, inspects DOM, verifies visual acceptance criteria against running Tauri app. Posts unified PASS/FAIL results + screenshots as a single GitHub comment.

retro-analyst.description: Post-spec retrospective analyst. Analyzes metrics, errors, and cross-spec patterns. Generates improvement PR with doc updates, guardrails, and prompt fixes. Posts Retro Report on backlog issue.

planner-subagent.description: Product Owner subagent for auditing and simulation. Clarifies requirements, creates backlog issues, dispatches Architect. Resumes for final report. Same prompt as Planner, subagent mode.
